card.name: Spots just before a named drug or subject
card.fires_on: Small connecting words or breaks right before a product name or the action of a subject, such as 'including' before a brand name after SGLT2 inhibitors, or 'or' after Insulin Degludec. Also a gap before a dose number and inside brand names like SYNJARDY XR.
